senses.en: a small round object sewn onto clothes to fasten them
senses.zh: 缝在衣服上用来扣合的小圆扣；纽扣

example.en: She lost a button from her coat.
example.zh: 她外套上掉了一颗纽扣。

senses.en: a small part you press to make a machine work

example.en: Press the red button to stop the machine.
example.zh: 按下红色按钮停止机器。

example.en: He buttoned his shirt before leaving.

senses.en: a small pin or badge worn on clothes

example.en: She wore a campaign button on her jacket.
example.zh: 她在夹克上别了一枚竞选徽章。
